author: pgaudet
body:
The proposal has been made to obsolete 

- GO:0006735 NADH regeneration: there is no evidence that this process exists, there is plenty of NADH in cells
- GO:0006740 NADPH regeneration: consider GO:0006098 'pentose-phosphate shunt'
- GO:0009780 photosynthetic NADP+ reduction: The reason for obsoletion is that the data from the paper for which the term was requested can be accurately described using GO:0009773 'photosynthetic electron transport in photosystem I'.

There are 20 annotations to these terms: 

Group | Count 
-- | --
SGD | 5
ComplexPortal | 2
EcoCyc | 2
MGI | 4
UniProt | 5
TAIR | 1

See https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1zqa0aM2TbbROCRIYm56TDuFuA_KiiZFFYtORsIbQbxI/edit?gid=0#gid=0
